parts.notes: Toshiba named replacement for TLP3543 (product page 'Recommended Product', 'package and characteristics are almost same'; discontinuation notice Apr 2024 maps TLP3543(F)->TLP3543A(F, TLP3543(LF1,F)->TLP3543A(LF1,F, TLP3543(TP1,F)->TLP3543A(TP1,F). vs TLP3543: VOFF 30V (was 20V), ION 5A (was 4A), RON 40mOhm max (was 50mOhm), tOFF 0.5ms max (was 1ms). Pins 1=anode, 2=cathode, 3=NC, 4/6=drain, 5=source - identical to the predecessor's datasheet pin assignment, so the stock TLP3543 symbol is reused. 7.62mm row pitch, 2.54mm pin pitch, body 6.4x7.12mm; same 11-7A8S package as the predecessor. Connection ratings: A (AC/DC, pins 4-6) 5A; B (DC, source pin 5 used) 5A/10mOhm typ; C (DC, drains paralleled) 10A/5mOhm typ @ ION=10A. tON 3ms max / tOFF 0.5ms max at IF=10mA. Operating temp: abs max Topr -40 to 110C (recommended -40 to 85C; the UL 508-recognized ratings table limits Topr to -40..85C). Orderable numbers carry a lead-free suffix ('(F' / ',F', e.g. TLP3543A(F) plus optional packing codes (TP1/TP4/TP5) and VDE option (D4); mpn keeps the base number. Variant listed in the datasheet's Ordering Information.

parts.notes: Toshiba named replacement for TLP3542, TLP3544, TLP3545 (product page 'Recommended Product', 'package and characteristics are almost same'; discontinuation notice Apr 2024 maps TLP3542/TLP3544/TLP3545 (F),(LF1,F),(TP1,F) -> TLP3545A (F,(LF1,F,(TP1,F). vs TLP3545: 4A (was 3A), RON 60mOhm max (was 70mOhm), tOFF 0.5ms max (was 1ms). Replacing TLP3542 (5-pin DIP6-cut, no pin 5, 60V/2.5A/100mOhm): Toshiba rates it 'package and characteristics almost same, different switching speed'; TLP3545A has a source pin 5 (NC-able in A connection) so a TLP3542 DIP-5-6 footprint needs a pad/hole at pin 5 or the pin trimmed. Replacing TLP3544 (40V/3.5A): TLP3545A meets or exceeds it. Pins 1=anode, 2=cathode, 3=NC, 4/6=drain, 5=source - identical to the predecessor's datasheet pin assignment, so the stock TLP3545 symbol is reused. 7.62mm row pitch, 2.54mm pin pitch, body 6.4x7.12mm; same 11-7A8S package as the predecessor. Connection ratings: A (AC/DC, pins 4-6) 4A; B (DC, source pin 5 used) 4A/18mOhm typ; C (DC, drains paralleled) 8A/9mOhm typ @ ION=8A. tON 3ms max / tOFF 0.5ms max at IF=10mA. Operating temp: abs max Topr -40 to 110C (recommended -40 to 85C; the UL 508-recognized ratings table limits Topr to -40..85C). Orderable numbers carry a lead-free suffix ('(F' / ',F', e.g. TLP3545A(F) plus optional packing codes (TP1/TP4/TP5) and VDE option (D4); mpn keeps the base number. Variant listed in the datasheet's Ordering Information.

`replaces` is a list of predecessor base part numbers. On lead-form variants it names the predecessor family; the notice maps variants one-to-one only for (F) and (LF1,F)/(TP1,F) (predecessors had no (LF5)/(LF4)/F wide versions in terra).

LIFECYCLE OF THE PREDECESSORS: Toshiba's Apr-24-2024 discontinuation notice gives last-time buy Jun 30, 2025 and last-time shipment Sep 30, 2025 for TLP3123, TLP3542, TLP3543, TLP3544, TLP3545, TLP3546 (all (F)/(LF1,F)/(TP1,F) variants). As of 2026-10-01 these are past last shipment, so toshiba_catalog.json's 'EOL' for them is stale; they should be Obsolete (Toshiba product pages still say 'EOL announced'). toshiba_catalog.json was not modified.
The notice also lists TLP3542(LF1,F), TLP3543(LF1,F) and TLP3546(LF1,F) as orderable numbers, which toshiba_catalog.json left out for lack of evidence (moot now they are discontinued).
All variant rows come from each datasheet's 'Ordering Information' table. Packing codes (TP1/TP4/TP5, TPL/TPR) and VDE options (D4, V4) are not separate rows.
Operating temperature max is the absolute-maximum Topr (110C); recommended operating max is 85C (TLP354xA) or 100C (TLP3122A/TLP176AM).
Datasheet PDFs carry 2026-04-07 revision footers although Toshiba's file names are dated 2023/2025.
